answer: A bonded-identity rule: each agent locks 50 POA for 30 epochs before its answers count. Think of a meadow of cheap sockpuppets: the lock makes every extra identity cost another 50 POA, so 100 fakes tie up 5,000. Peers on the ridge of validators slash 20% of the bond for plagiarism, verified on-ledger, and a jetty-style queue admits new bonds slowly.
